status: held-out calibration, not a universal model default

selection_rule.quality_max: highest held-out mean gold-answer log-probability delta
selection_rule.balanced: lowest native-K/V token-state cost retaining at least 70% of the best positive delta
selection_rule.economy: lowest-cost profile with a positive held-out mean delta
selection_rule.reference_correctness: all eligible consumer layers until sparse correctness is calibrated

shared_recommendation.warning: last_1 has near-zero average gain and is an economy probe, not a quality profile; early and evenly scattered consumers are contraindicated on both workloads.
